description: Extract pages from a PDF or split it into separate files. A HelpySelf tool (helpyself.com).

data.description: The PDF to split, base64-encoded. A data: URL prefix is stripped.

mode.description: extract returns one PDF holding the selected pages; single returns one PDF per selected page. `files` in the response is an array either way.

name.description: Base name for the output files; a .pdf ending is dropped. extract mode names the result <name>-extracted.pdf, single mode <name>-page-N.pdf per page.

pages.description: Which pages to take, counted from 1: single pages and ranges separated by commas, such as "1-3, 7, 12-", where an open end runs to the last page. The order given is kept, so "3, 1" puts page 3 first. Omit for every page.

name: pdf_split
title: Split PDF
